WELCOME TO THE FITCHBURG CITY COUNCIL 
 
 
December 1, 2026 
 
Fitchburg Legislative Building 
700 Main Street 
Fitchburg MA  01420 
7:00 PM 
 
This meeting can also be viewed live on FATV.  Go to www.fatv.org/watch-fatv for more 
information on accessing this meeting.   
 
This is intended to help you understand the meeting format and assist you with the rules  
of the Council as they pertain to your participation. 
 
All meetings of the Fitchburg City council are open to the public.  This does not mean that 
the public participates in all aspects of the meeting.  It simply means that the meeting  
itself, including all discussions and votes, is open for public view. 
 
Executive Session  
The only time a Council meeting can be closed to the public is when 
the Council votes for Executive Session in order to discuss sensitive 
matters in private, such as pending litigation.  Any votes taken 
however, must be taken in open session. 
 
OPPORTUNITIES FOR THE PUBLIC TO SPEAK DURING A COUNCIL MEETING: 
 
Public Forum   
The Public Forum occurs immediately following the Pledge of 
Allegiance.  The President will ask if anyone in the audience wishes 
to speak on any matter appearing on the Agenda.  If you wish to 
address the Council, you must stand and be recognized and follow 
these rules before speaking: 
 
1. State your name and city of residence. 
2. Approach the center table and either stand or sit.  This allows 
you to be seen and heard clearly by everyone in attendance. 
3. You may speak only on items appearing on the agenda for 
no more than (2) minutes.  Copies of the agenda are 
available on the center table prior to the meeting. 
4. Please state the petition, order, ordinance, or resolution 
number to which you refer. 
 
Public Hearings   
Public hearings are held on various issues such as Special Permits and 
Zoning changes.  The same rules apply with the following exceptions: 
 
1. You must stand and be recognized either “in favor” or “in 
opposition” when asked by the Council President. 
2. You need not refer to the petition number. 
If you have any questions or comments either before or after the meeting,  
any Councilor would be happy to assist you. 
Thank you for your interest!

193-26. ORDER THAT: the City of Fitchburg hereby approves the expenditure of funds from 
the Department of Fire Services SAFE Grant in the approximate amount of SIX 
THOUSAND ONE HUNDRED FOURTEEN AND 64/100 DOLLARS ($6,114.64) 
for the purpose of delivering fire and life safety education to students in the city. 
 
194-26. ORDER THAT: the City of Fitchburg hereby approves the expenditure of funds from 
the Department of Fire Services Senior SAFE Grant in the approximate amount of 
TWO THOUSAND FOUR HUNDRED FORTY-FOUR AND 64/100 DOLLARS 
($2,444.64) for the purpose of delivering fire and life safety education to seniors in 
the city. 
 
195-26. ORDER THAT: the City of Fitchburg approves the expenditure of grant funds from 
the Blue Cross Blue Shield of MA Foundation OB3 Defense Grant, in the amount of 
SIXTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($60,000) to mitigate the number of residents 
experiencing loss of insurance coverage. 
 
196-26. ORDER THAT: the City of Fitchburg hereby approves the expenditure of grant funds 
from the Mass DEP Sustainable Material Recovery Program - Recycling Dividends 
Fund, in the approximate amount of THIRTY THOUSAND DOLLARS ($30,000) to 
implement programs and policies to maximize the reuse, recycling, and waste 
reduction of curbside and drop-off disposal in Fitchburg.

 (Economic Development)

204-26. Submitted by Council President Anthony Zarrella, on behalf of the School 
Committee: 
 
That the City Council of the City of Fitchburg, pursuant to Massachusetts General 
Laws Chapter 71, Section 52, consider and approve the establishment of an annual 
stipend of $5,000 for each elected member of the Fitchburg School Committee, in 
recognition of the responsibilities, time commitment, and public service associated 
with the position. 
 
Further, that the City Council request the City Solicitor to prepare any necessary 
ordinance or other legislative language to implement said compensation, consistent 
with applicable Massachusetts General Laws and the Fitchburg City Charter. 
 
The annual stipend shall become effective upon the organization of the City 
government following the next regular municipal election, anticipated in January 
2028, subject to confirmation of the applicable legal requirements. 
  (Legislative Affairs)
